extracted.intended_audience: policy makers, national IP/statistics authorities, publishing industry researchers and analysts
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and using WIPO's defined indicators and data items for the publishing/creative economy (trade and educational sectors, legal deposits, ISBNs, and related tables) for 2019. Includes definitions and cautions for cross-country comparison and data interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical indications in force by protection type
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of GIs in force by national/regional authority broken down by protection mechanism: Total; Sui generis; Trademarks; Other national legal means; Regional system; Agreements; Unknown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table reports 2019 counts; some jurisdictions (e.g., Czech Republic, France, Italy and Lisbon System) do not have product-category data and may be omitted in some graphs; note that Switzerland has no registration requirement for sui generis protection so counting rules differ by country. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: F1. Trade sector revenue (USD million), 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total sales and licensing revenue for the trade sector in 2019, measured in USD million.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for 21 countries (combined revenue reported); caution: data are incomplete/partial, national publishers’ associations (NPAs) coverage varies; methodological differences across countries; * indicates 2018 data; revenue from some countries (Italy, Hungary) reported at market value. Source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F2. Share of children’s books within trade sector revenue, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage share of trade sector revenue attributable to children’s books for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for countries that provided subsector breakdowns; use caution due to incomplete coverage and differing NPA representation; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F3. Children’s books revenue (USD million), 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total revenue generated from sales of children’s books in 2019, measured in USD million.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for a subset of countries (13 reported); interpret with caution due to partial data coverage and methodological differences; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F4. Distribution of trade sector revenue by format, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of trade sector revenue in 2019 by format (print, digital, other) expressed as shares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ten countries provided format breakdowns; print generally dominant but digital shares vary; caution about incompleteness and comparability; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F5. Distribution of trade sector revenue by destination, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of trade sector revenue in 2019 by destination market (domestic vs foreign).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported where destination market data available (10 countries); domestic sales typically bulk of revenue but foreign sales share varies; interpret with caution; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F6. Distribution of trade sector revenue by sales channel, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of trade sector revenue by sales channel (brick-and-mortar, online, other) for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seven countries provided sales-channel breakdown; online share exceeds brick-and-mortar in some markets (e.g., Sweden, U.K.); caution about limited reporting and comparability; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F7. Number of titles published by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of titles published in 2019 by the trade sector (print, digital, other combined).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data available for 38 countries; trade sector usually accounts for majority of titles; caution: NPAs coverage and methodological differences affect comparability; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F8. Share of children’s books in the number of titles published by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage share of children’s books among trade-sector titles published in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for countries with available data (31 countries for children’s books count); interpret with caution due to data incompleteness and methodological variation; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F9. Number of children’s books titles published by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute count of children’s book titles published by the trade sector in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for 31 countries; cross-country comparisons should be cautious because of differing reporting scope; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F10. Distribution of titles published by the trade sector by format, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of trade-sector titles published in different formats (print, digital, other) in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 21 countries disaggregated titles by format; some countries show high digital shares; caution about coverage and comparability; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F11. Number of copies sold by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of copies sold in 2019 by the trade sector (measured in millions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade-sector copies sold data available for 18 countries; the U.S. reported the largest share; interpret with caution due to partial reporting and methodological differences; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F12. Share of children’s books in the number of copies sold by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage share of copies sold that are children’s books in the trade sector for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported where available; limited country coverage and comparability caveats apply; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F13. Number of copies of children’s books sold by the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute number of children’s books copies sold by the trade sector in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for countries reporting children’s book sales; use caution for cross-country comparisons; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F14. Distribution of copies sold by sales channel for the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of copies sold in the trade sector by sales channel (brick-and-mortar, online, other) for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by a subset of countries; indicates channel-specific market share; interpret cautiously given limited reporting; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F15. Distribution of copies sold by format in the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of copies sold in the trade sector by format (print, digital, other) in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for countries that disaggregated sales by format (digital shares notable in some markets); comparability caveats apply; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F16. Distribution of copies sold by destination in the trade sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of trade-sector copies sold by destination (domestic vs foreign) in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for a subset of countries; domestic sales often dominate; interpretation should consider data coverage limitations; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F17. Educational sector revenue (USD million), 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total sales and licensing revenue for the educational sector in 2019, measured in USD million.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revenue data available for 19 countries; the U.S. and Japan reported >USD 7 billion each; caution: partial coverage and methodological differences; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F18. Distribution of educational sector revenue by format, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of educational-sector revenue in 2019 by format (print, digital, other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Five countries reported format breakdowns; print typically accounts for majority of educational revenue but digital shares can be substantial in some countries; interpret with caution; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F19. Distribution of educational sector revenue by destination, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of educational-sector revenue generated from domestic vs foreign markets in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data available for a small number of countries; e.g., U.K. and New Zealand reported high foreign shares; use care comparing across countries; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F20. Distribution of educational sector revenue by sales channel, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of educational-sector revenue by sales channel (brick-and-mortar, online, other) for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by a subset of countries; interpret with caution due to limited reporting and methodological differences; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F21. Number of titles published by the educational sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of titles published by the educational sector in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data available for 34 countries; Turkey and France reported high numbers; use caution for cross-country comparisons; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F22. Distribution of titles published by the educational sector by format, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of educational-sector titles published in different formats (print, digital, other) in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disaggregation available for some countries; Cuba reported a majority digital share for educational titles; interpret carefully given coverage differences; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F23. Number of copies sold by the educational sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of copies sold by the educational sector in 2019 (absolute counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for 15 countries; Turkey reported the highest number; beware of partial reporting and differences in measurement; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F24. Distribution of copies sold by format by the educational sector, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of copies sold in the educational sector by format (print, digital, other) for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported where format disaggregation is provided; digital shares vary across reporting countries; interpret with caution; source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: F25. Distribution of books deposited in a recognized repository by format, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of books deposited in legal repositories in 2019 by format (print, digital, others).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disaggregated deposit data reported by 36 countries; digital deposit shares vary widely (e.g., Germany high due to digitization of records); careful when comparing cross-country because legal deposit obligations and practices differ.

rubrics_metrics.name: F26. Total number of music sheets deposited in a recognized repository, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute count of music sheets deposited in legal repositories in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thirty countries reported music sheet deposits; U.K. reported highest number; note that some countries collect music data via other agencies; interpret accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: F27. Total number of music audio deposited in a recognized repository, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute count of music audio files deposited in legal repositories in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data available for 33 countries; Finland and Germany reported large audio deposits; collection responsibilities may vary across countries which affects comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: F28. Distribution of music sheets and music audio deposited in a recognized repository, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Share breakdown between music sheets and music audio among deposited music items in legal repositories for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the composition of music deposits (some countries dominated by audio deposits); interpret with awareness of national collection practices and reporting scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: F29. Total number of films and videos deposited in a recognized repository, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute count of films and videos deposited in legal repositories in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data are available for 22 countries; some audiovisual deposit data collected by non-library agencies in specific countries (e.g., Finland, Italy); the Republic of Korea reported the highest number.

rubrics_metrics.name: F30. Total net publishing industry revenue by sector (USD million), 2019 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table F30 presenting total net publishing industry revenue for 2019 by sector (USD million).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistical table form of F1; includes notes about data incompleteness, NPAs coverage variation, and * indicating 2018 data or market-value reporting for some countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: F31. Total number of titles published by sector, 2019 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table F31 reporting total number of titles published in 2019 by sector (trade and educational).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides country-by-country title counts and by-sector splits where available; cross-country comparisons should consider differing NPA coverage and methodologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: F32. Total number of copies sold by sector (million), 2019 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table F32 reporting total number of copies sold in 2019 by sector, measured in millions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes trade and educational sector copies sold where reported; interpret results cautiously because of partial country reporting and methodological differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: F33. Total number of books deposited in a recognized repository, 2019 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table F33 showing counts of books deposited in legal repositories in 2019 by country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes notes on digital vs print deposits and national legal deposit obligations; some large markets did not participate (e.g., U.S., China) so global totals are incomplete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal deposit (definition & counting guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal deposit is a statutory obligation requiring publishers to deposit a certain number of copies of published documents at a recognized repository; national provisions vary (often at least two copies), and obligations may apply only to printed books or also to digital/other formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because practices differ (which formats are mandatory, voluntary digital deposits, recent digitization projects), cross-country comparisons should be made with care. Some countries' digital deposits may include bulk projects (e.g., New Zealand case law bulk submissions).

rubrics_metrics.name: ISBN identifier and registration counts (lifetime and 2019)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of ISBNs registered (lifetime and in 2019) as indicators of publishing output; ISBN is an international standard book identifier administered by the International ISBN Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ISBN data indicate publication activity but can double-count alternative formats (hardback, paperback, e-book each get separate ISBNs). The ISBN administrative structure is three-tiered (International Agency, registration agencies, publishers). Lifetime and annual registration counts available for select countries; interpret with understanding of double counting and differing registration practices.
